theme: Lesson 1 beginning: Popo, Toto, Pipi, Gigi, and Momo are playing together in Sunflower Meadow when they hear a faint chirping sound coming from a nearby bush.

roleplay_scenarios.scene_description: Popo and friends found a bird trapped in a bush.
roleplay_scenarios.player_goal: Offer to help the bird get out of the bush.
similar_answers: Let me help you, little bird!
I'll get you out of there!
Don't worry, I'll help you!
hint_sequence: Look at Page 7 where Popo says 'I can help. I'll get you out!'
Think about how you would feel if you were trapped and someone offered to help.
Remember, we're learning to be kind and helpful friends like Popo.

theme: Lesson 2 development: The friends discover a lost baby bird trapped in the bush, and Popo decides to help it by carefully removing the thorns.

roleplay_scenarios.scene_description: The friends found a baby bird trapped in the bush. They want to help it.
roleplay_scenarios.player_goal: Help Popo decide how to carefully remove thorns from around the baby bird.
roleplay_scenarios.model_answer: We have to be careful so we don't hurt the little bird.
similar_answers: Let's be gentle, or it might get hurt.
We need to be careful so the baby bird doesn't get hurt.
We should be gentle when we touch the thorns.
hint_sequence: Look at Page 2 of the story for what Popo said about being gentle.
Think about how you would feel if you were trapped like the baby bird.
Remember, the friends want to help the bird safely.

theme: Lesson 3 challenge: As Popo tries to free the bird, he realizes that his mane is getting tangled with the thorns, making it harder to move.

roleplay_scenarios.scene_description: Popo's mane is tangled with thorns and he needs help to untangle it.
roleplay_scenarios.player_goal: Ask Popo if you can help him untangle his mane.
similar_answers: Popo, do you need my help?
May I help you with your mane?
I can help you untangle it, Popo!
hint_sequence: Look at Page 3 to see what Popo asked Gigi for.
Remember when Gigi helped Popo in the story.
You can use a friendly tone and ask if they need help.

theme: Lesson 4 turning point: Toto uses her quick thinking and agility to carefully cut Popo's mane using a nearby rock, freeing him from the thorns.

roleplay_scenarios.scene_description: Popo the lion got stuck in Sunflower Meadow and his friends want to help him.
roleplay_scenarios.player_goal: Encourage Toto to express her willingness to help Popo.
similar_answers: Let me help you, Popo!
We should work together to get you out!
I'll do my best to help you!
hint_sequence: Remember what Toto said on page 2?
Think about how Toto helped Popo in the story.
What would you say if your friend needed help?

theme: Lesson 5 transformation: With Popo freed, they all work together to create a makeshift pulley system using vines and sticks to lift the bird out of the bush.

roleplay_scenarios.scene_description: Popo's friends want to lift Pipi out of the bush.
roleplay_scenarios.player_goal: Offer help to lift Pipi out of the bush.
roleplay_scenarios.model_answer: I can help! Let's work together!
similar_answers: We should do it together, right?
Can I help you guys lift Pipi?
Let me help, we can do it!
hint_sequence: Look at page 2 for Toto's idea.
Remember what Popo said on page 6.
Think about how friends work together.

theme: Lesson 6 obstacle: As they're about to reach the bird's nest, strong winds start blowing, making it difficult for them to hold onto their creation.

roleplay_scenarios.scene_description: Popo and friends are trying to reach the bird's nest, but strong winds are making it hard.
roleplay_scenarios.player_goal: Encourage Popo with a reassuring message when he's struggling to hold onto the nest.
roleplay_scenarios.model_answer: Don't worry, Popo! We've got this!
similar_answers: We can do it, Popo! Just hang on!
You're doing great, Popo! Keep going!
I'm here with you, Popo. We'll get through this!
hint_sequence: Remember what Momo said to help Popo feel better.
Think about a time when someone helped you feel more confident.
Use a kind and encouraging tone of voice.

theme: Lesson 7 plan: Pipi uses her sharp eyesight to spot a nearby tree with sturdy branches that can provide shelter from the wind, and Gigi uses his long neck to tie the pulley system to the branches.

roleplay_scenarios.scene_description: Popo and his friends are working together to create a pulley system.
roleplay_scenarios.player_goal: Offer help to your friend who needs it.
similar_answers: Let me do that for you!
I'll lend a hand!
Can I give you a hand?
hint_sequence: Look at Page 7 where Popo says 'I can help!'
Think about what it means to be a good friend.
Remember, helping others makes us happy!

theme: Lesson 8 rescue: With the wind reduced, Momo uses his digging skills to create a small trench beneath the bird's nest, allowing them to carefully lower it into place.

roleplay_scenarios.scene_description: Momo and his friends are rescuing a bird's nest.
roleplay_scenarios.player_goal: Ask for help to make the nest cozy for the baby birds.
roleplay_scenarios.model_answer: Can you guys help me put some leaves in the nest?
similar_answers: Can we all work together to make the nest comfy?
Do you think we could add some soft leaves to the nest?
Let's all help Momo make the nest cozy for the baby birds.
hint_sequence: Look at Page 4, what did Popo say he wanted to do?
Remember how Gigi and Pipi helped Momo on Page 6.
Think about how you can help your friends when they need it.

theme: Lesson 9 celebration: The friends successfully return the baby bird to its relieved mother, who thanks them with a special gift – the handmade wooden birdhouse.

roleplay_scenarios.scene_description: Popo and friends want to take care of the birdhouse.
roleplay_scenarios.player_goal: Encourage Popo to express his willingness to help with taking care of the birdhouse.
roleplay_scenarios.model_answer: I want to help take care of the birdhouse too!
similar_answers: Can I help make the birdhouse happy?
I'd love to help with taking care of our new friend's home!
Let me help with little tasks, like bringing water and twigs!
hint_sequence: Look at what Popo said on page 5.
Think about how the friends worked together to return the baby bird.
Remember what Momo said about being a great team.

theme: Lesson 10 ending: Popo and friends proudly display their new birdhouse in Sunflower Meadow, knowing that they've not only helped someone in need but also learned valuable lessons about teamwork and bravery.

roleplay_scenarios.scene_description: Popo and friends are celebrating their new birdhouse in Sunflower Meadow.
roleplay_scenarios.player_goal: Express gratitude for teamwork and help from friends.
roleplay_scenarios.model_answer: I'm so happy we worked together to build this beautiful home!
similar_answers: We did it! Our birdhouse is amazing because of all our friends helping us.
Thank you, everyone, for building such a wonderful home with me!
Our new birdhouse is the best because we all helped each other.
